hound.name: Hound
hound.text: Finds what others hide: debtors, snitches, treasure. Tracks prey and strikes when the time is right.
hound.xpTrigger: Gain xp when you address a challenge with tracking or violence.
list: What are they about to do?
How can I get them to [X]?

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.text: Push yourself to make a shot at incredible distance or to suppress a small gang with covering fire.

focused.name: Focused
focused.text: Special armor: resist consequences of surprise, mental harm or losing the trail, or push yourself when shooting or tracking for free.

ghost-hound.name: Ghost Hound
ghost-hound.text: Your pet gains potency against the supernatural and one arcane trait; can be taken twice.

scout.name: Scout
scout.text: +1 effect when you hunt for a target; +1d to avoid detection from a prepared position or in disguise.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.text: Immune to the poisonous fumes of the deathlands; +1 stress box.

tenacious.name: Tenacious
tenacious.text: Penalties from harm are reduced by one category; level 4 harm is still fatal.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.text: An extra xp trigger: payback for harm done to you or someone close; the crew gains xp too if they helped.

pair-of-fine-pistols.name: Pair of Fine Pistols
pair-of-fine-pistols.text: Double-barreled pistols: each can fire again without reloading.

fine-long-rifle.name: Fine Long Rifle
fine-long-rifle.text: A long-range hunting weapon, awkward up close.

electroplasmic-ammunition.name: Electroplasmic Ammunition
electroplasmic-ammunition.text: Good against spirits, stuns people; in the book it carries a Spirit Wardens clock of 4 segments.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.text: Collapsible; can be mounted on a rifle as a scope.

steiner.name: Steiner
steiner.text: An old rival or former partner.

celene.name: Celene
celene.text: A guard or bodyguard: whom does she protect?

melvir.name: Melvir
melvir.text: Perhaps an old friend who has patched you up many times.

veleris.name: Veleris
veleris.text: Who does he send information to?

casta.name: Casta
casta.text: Perhaps she taught you to shoot and hunt.
